summary: Creative Global Technology Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Second Extraordinary General Meeting held September 9, 2026 in Hong Kong, at which shareholders adopted the Fourth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association and granted ancillary authorizations. Holders of 567,045 Class A and 566,667 Class B shares, about 65.94% of outstanding shares, constituted a quorum; all three proposals passed overwhelmingly, with the adjournment proposal moot. The company expects to file the amended charter with the Cayman Registrar within fifteen days. No special-situation transaction, price, stake, or advisor is disclosed; routine charter-amendment and meeting matters only.
